$comment: Demo-only recipe for the ATT&CK persistence subset (columns id, title, tactic, parent, description). It is the recipe the command line builds by default for this file (one folder per parent technique, a parent link on every sub-technique, children lists and level hub notes), plus one nested tag per note naming its tactic and parent technique. Facet hub notes are left off so the tags do not add a second, duplicate node per technique.
